# The required status check CONTEXT STRINGS for master, as branch protection
# reports them. Read by CB-2100 (comply gate-effect verification) so the rule
# can be evaluated on a runner that has no admin read on the repository.
#
# This file is CROSS-CHECKED, not trusted: whenever the branch-protection API
# is reachable, CB-2100 fails on any disagreement between the two. Do not edit
# it to make a gate look reachable — regenerate it from the API:
#
#   gh api repos/paiml/paiml-mcp-agent-toolkit/branches/master/protection \
#     --jq '.required_status_checks.contexts[]'
#
# Note that these are CONTEXTS, not job names. `ci / gate` is a job inside the
# reusable workflow ci.yml calls; the unrequired top-level job in ci.yml whose
# display name is `gate` reports as plain `gate` and is a different check.

feature-gate
docs build (docs.rs environment)

mutation-diff
